title: Linux test cleanup sweeps only its own hermetic run's daemons
goal: scripts/kill-leftover-service-runs.sh on Linux killed every checkout-built daemon with a temp SUSI_HOME, including daemons of other test binaries running in parallel release-qualify lanes (v0.21.67 qualification failed twice in host_only_privacy and peer_channel_hub). Require the invocation's SUSI_HERMETIC_FORBIDDEN marker in the target process, failing closed without it, as the Windows branch already does.
